spans.s:
r. 10th cl. (कुहयते)
1 To surprise, to astonish, to excite wonder.
2 To cheat, to impose upon.

m. (-हः)
A name of KUVERA.
f. (-हा)
A medicinal drug: see कटुकी.
ind.
Where, whither, used in the Vedas in place of कुत्र.
E.
कु vile, and हा to leave, affix ड.

f. (-हा)
A fog, a mist.
E.
कुह to astonish, अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
A cheat, a rogue, a juggler.
m. (-कः)
Juggling, deception, slight-of-hand, &c.
E.
कुह to astonish, क्वुन् aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Juggling, conjuring, cheating.
E.
कुहक, and कार who makes; also कुहककारक and कुहककारिन्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Suspicious, cautious, wary.
E.
कुहक, and चकित fearful.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Living by slight-of-hand, a conjuror, a cheat, &c.
E.
कुहक deception, and जीविन् who lives by.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Juggling, conjuring, slight-of-hand.
2 Hypocrisy.
E.
कुहक, and वृत्ति practice.

m. (-नः)
A wild cock.
E.
कुहक deception, and खन who sounds.

m. (-रः)
A wild cock: see the preceding.

Envious.
2

Hypocritical.
m. (-नः)
1 A rat.
2 A snake.
f. (-ना)
Hypocrisy, assumed and sanctity, the interested performance of religious austerities.
n. (-नं)
1 A small earthen vessel.
2 A glass vessel.
E.
कुह to surprise, युच् aff.

f. (-ना)
Hypocrisy, affectation of religious zeal or austerity: see कुहना.

f. (-का)
Hypocrisy: see the preceding.
E.
कुहन, and इकन् aff.

n. (-रं)
1 A cavity, a hollow.
2 A hole, a rent, &c.
3 The ear.
4 A guttural sound.
5 The throat or larynx.
m. (-रः)
A kind of snake.
E.
कु the earth, &c. and हर what takes, &c. from हृ with the affix अप्.

n. (-तं)
1 The song, or cry of the Kokila, the Indian cuckoo.
2 Vox congressus in coitu.
3 A sound in general.
E.
कुहर, and इतच् aff.

m. (-लिः)
A Pān, the leaf of the Piper betel, with small pieces of the Areca nut, and Catechu and a little lime, which are chewed and eaten by the Oriental nations.

f. (-हुः)
See the next.

f. (-हूः)
1 New moon; the first day of the first quarter on which the moon rises invisible.
2 The cry of the Koïl or Indian cuckoo.
E.
कुह to astonish, ऊः affix, or with कु affix कुहु.

m. (-कः)
The Indian cuckoo.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-ण्ठः)
The Kokila or Indian cuckoo.
E.
कुहू the Kokila's cry, and कण्ठ the throat.

m. (-लः)
The king of turtles, the tortoise supposed to uphold the world.

m. (-खः)
The Kokila: see the preceding.

m. (-वः)
The Kokila.
E.
कुहू, and रव sound.

n. (-लं)
A pit, filled with stakes.

f. (-का)
A fog, a mist, haze, haziness.
E.
कु the earth, हेड to surround, वुन् affix; also कुहेलिक and कुहेडी.

f. (-डी)
See the preceding: also कुहेली.

f. (-का)
Fog, mist: see कुहेडिका, ल being changed to ड.
